'''Mount Dijandi''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Otavon XII]].<ref name="thb" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] fought and then killed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Hylon]] on the mountain's peak.<ref name="thb" />
